description.value:
Targets 2 creatures

You take in two patients at once. Diagnose two creatures rather than one with a single use of Diagnosis. Both must be within your usual range for it, and everything a single Diagnosis would tell you about each, you learn about both. Any feat or feature that triggers on Diagnosing a creature triggers for both.

cinderfall.incomplete: Diagnosis is this class's own signature action (per the class card's flags.cinderfall.terms entry, classes.plaguesworn.json:82). A corpus-wide search (find site/data/cards -iname "*diagnos*") turns up only unrelated Old World Construct ancestry cards plus the three plaguesworn feats that reference it -- there is no "Diagnosis" action card anywhere in the corpus for a feat that keys off "when you Diagnose" to hook into or modify. The action itself doesn't exist as a card to retarget.
